title: Changelog - November 2016 | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Changelog - November 2016 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093658 New Features: New Widget on Admin Dashboard, now Site's Admin can see the most recent members members that log in to the site. Images Update for Admin Member Blog Posts, for further information click here . Nested text labels are now available to all customers. For more information click here . Multiple text labels have been created: away and within label for search results pages, create_listing_below on Account Member Dashboard, result_label_activation_email on Account Member Dashboard, "Request More Review Section" was converted to text labels. Enhancements / Fixes: Bug fixes through the New Leads Module, Search Results Pages. Final Adjustment to the New Reviews Module, click here for more information. In summary more than 25+ bugs fixed ranging from Backend, Admin Panel, Frontend and more. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
